description: NaLi₅Fe₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.43 Å. There are five inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.22 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-89°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.48 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 69-87°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.49 Å. In the fourth Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 69-85°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.30 Å. In the fifth Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.42 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.38 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.32 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond lengths. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and corners with four LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-60°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and corners with five LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-61°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP tetrahedra that share corners with three OLi₂FeP tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂FeP tetrahedra that share corners with six ONaLiFeP tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one OLi₂FeP tetrahedra. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂FeP tetrahedra that share corners with four OLi₂FeP tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONaLiFeP trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one OLi₃C tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂FeP tetrahedra that share corners with five ONaLiFeP tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one OLi₂FeP tetrahedra. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to three Li and one C atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₃C tetrahedra.
